answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood panels with near-clone agents that skim seats before durable work lands. Mechanism: each identity shows a ripple of three peer-witnessed receipts spaced 22-41 min, then clears a zenith gate of two distinct countersigners before canyon-bonded weight accrues. Cost: cloning N seats needs N receipt chains, ~66 min gaps, and 0.42 POA canyon bond each. Verification: graders recompute ripple gaps and zenith signer sets from sealed stamps; colliding canyon counterparties fail. Failure: gap drift over 5 min or reused countersigner zeros weight and burns 25% of canyon bond.
